records.precondition: H=0.30 m, no phase alignment. At 5 mm the maximum density deviation is 2.908%, exceeding the 1% weak-compressibility gate.

records.precondition: second benchmark family for this method (the Sod tube, a 10:1 driver with a 1.3-Mach shock and a 3.4x contact jump, is the first): stationary outer states, pressure ratio 1000:1, 10.3x contact density jump, shock Mach ~4.6. What is NOT gated: the rarefaction-fan interior (the fan crossing x(u*/2) carries a measured non-convergent 3 % bias -- the SPH fan converges to an S-shaped profile) and the contact-zone pressure spike (2.11 p* at N=800, reported as a diagnostic). Riemann data whose outer states move (Toro tests 2-5) is NOT representable in this fixed-mass reflecting box and is refused by riemann_topology.reflective_box_budget (Toro test 4: net boundary influx 90 % of the box mass).
records.quantity: max abs relative error over the gated star-plateau values (rho*_L, rho*_R, p*, u*) and the contact/shock positions
max normalised error vs the erfc similarity solution

records.precondition: second benchmark family for this operator (the 1-D erfc similarity profile is the first); the operator is the shipped Cleary-Monaghan pair sum, lifted to 2-D with the *vector* pair distance. The calibration is redone in 2-D -- the 1-D lattice factor does not transfer, see the refuted record and docs/case-conduction-2d.md
records.quantity: max normalised field error vs exp(-alpha (kx^2+ky^2) t) cos(kx x) cos(ky y) on a periodic square, n=128, RK4 time stepping, 2-D k->0 lattice calibration (gate 3 %)

records.precondition: refuted by construction: the raw 2-D operator's effective diffusivity is alpha_eff/alpha ~ 1.93 dx (O(dx)), so a 1-D dimensional factor mis-scales the 2-D run by ~1/dx. Kept in the registry so the trap is on the record and cannot be rediscovered as an accuracy claim
records.quantity: same family and resolution, but the 1-D lattice factor (1.0218) applied in 2-D: ~870 % -- O(dx) dimensional mismatch
